description:
Apply the seven renames decided by 'Rename review: the public tier, the options, the builtins, the error codes' (defk-wfi.3, see its resolution comment for the list and the reasons). In place, no deprecated aliases (nothing outside the repo depends on these names yet).

1. rotl64/2, rotr64/2 -> rotl/2, rotr/2 (builtin and Defk.Bits)
2. f64_to_u64/1 -> f64_bits/1 (builtin and Defk.Bits)
3. len/1 -> length/1 (builtin; Elixir mode must not clash with Kernel.length/1; docs: constant time)
4. use Defk, max_owned: -> max_owned_bytes: (also the error text and docs; __defk_stats__ key is unstable, rename it to match)
5. Defk.Errors.codes/0 -> entries/0
6. error code unknown-function -> undefined-function
7. error code u64-mix -> u64-with-i64

Every caller in lib, test, examples, bench, docs and the guides changes in the same change. Regenerate docs/compile-errors.md and docs/scope.md (docs/agents/generated-docs.md). CHANGELOG.md lists old and new names. ADR-0006's rename candidates section points to the decision.

Done when: no old name remains outside CHANGELOG.md and the ADR history, mix ci passes, and the examples still pass check-only (mix defk.examples --all).

comments.text:
Resolution: done, merged to main.
- The seven renames from defk-wfi.3, in place with no aliases: length/1, rotl/2, rotr/2, f64_bits/1 (builtins and Defk.Bits), use Defk, max_owned_bytes: (and the __defk_stats__ key and the out-of-memory text), Defk.Errors.entries/0, error codes undefined-function and u64-with-i64. CHANGELOG.md has the table; ADR-0006 points to the decision; 'codes are never renamed' now says 'from 0.1.0'.
- Behaviour change: length(a) on an array is the builtin; byte_size/1 and tuple_size/1 get undefined-function with the hint and rewrite length(a).
- Hidden C names stay: defk_rotl64, defk_rotr64, defk_f64_to_u64, defk_max_owned, DEFK_MAX_OWNED.
- Kept as history: docs/adr, docs/research, docs/cold-tests (dated session logs with verbatim compiler output).
- 111 files. lib by hand; test/, examples/+bench/ and the docs by three subagents with the Edit tool only. One test kernel renamed (f64_bits/1 -> f64_bits_f/1: a kernel may not take a builtin's name).
- Found on the way: the ex_slop check LengthComparison flags length(x) > literal in a kernel (it takes it for a list walk); in this repo one fixture binds the length first. Users of ex_slop (and of checks like it) may see the same false positive in their kernels.
- Results: mix ci 1737/1737 (credo and dialyzer clean); mix defk.examples --all 32/32 check-only on macOS; generated docs match the registry.

title: Apply the 0.1.0 renames
